privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains what personal data Timchenko Art collects when you use this site, how we use it, and what rights you have over your data.

sections.heading: What data we collect
sections.body: When you place an order, we collect your name, email address, phone number, and shipping address. We do not store payment card details — these are handled exclusively by our payment partners (Stripe, NOWPayments) under their own security policies.

sections.heading: How we use your data
sections.body: We use your data to process your order, communicate about shipping status, and meet legal obligations, including tax record-keeping.

sections.heading: Sharing with third parties
sections.body: We share only the minimum necessary data with payment providers and shipping carriers — solely to fulfill your order. We do not sell or share your data with advertising networks.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: This site uses functional cookies to remember your selected language, currency, and age confirmation. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: Under applicable data protection law (including GDPR for EU customers), you have the right to access, correct, and delete your personal data. Contact us at maryna.timchenko.art@gmail.com to exercise these rights.

termsOfService.title: Terms of Service
termsOfService.intro: These Terms govern your use of the Timchenko Art website and the purchase of paintings offered on it.

sections.heading: About this site
sections.body: Timchenko Art is the Merchant of Record for original oil paintings by the artist Marina. The artist creates the works and prepares them for shipment; all customer transactions are handled by the site.

sections.heading: Order restrictions
sections.body: We do not accept or process orders from customers located in the Russian Federation, in line with our position on its ongoing armed aggression against Ukraine.

sections.heading: Paintings and uniqueness
sections.body: Some gallery pieces may be repainted by the artist on request. Custom commissions are painted as one-of-a-kind originals and are not reproduced afterward.

sections.heading: Pricing and payment
sections.body: Prices may be displayed in your selected currency for convenience; the actual charge is processed through our payment provider (Stripe or NOWPayments) and may vary slightly depending on the conversion rate at the time of payment.

sections.heading: Age restriction
sections.body: This site is intended for adult visitors (18+), as some of the artwork shown may include nude subjects.

sections.heading: Governing law
sections.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of [jurisdiction — to confirm].

shippingPolicy.title: Shipping Policy
shippingPolicy.intro: This page explains how we pack, ship, and track your order.

sections.heading: Processing time
sections.body: Paintings marked "Ready" are typically shipped within [X] business days of payment. Custom commissions require time for the artist to complete the work — an estimated timeline is provided separately when you place the order.

sections.heading: Packaging
sections.body: Paintings are packed with their fragility in mind: rigid framing, protective corner guards, and moisture-resistant wrapping.

sections.heading: International shipping
sections.body: We ship to Ukraine, EU countries, Japan, and elsewhere. Customs duties and import taxes (where applicable) are the recipient's responsibility.

sections.heading: Order tracking
sections.body: Once your order ships, you'll receive a tracking number by email. On-site package tracking is currently in development.

returnsRefunds.title: Returns & Refunds
returnsRefunds.intro: This policy explains the terms for returning paintings and receiving refunds.

sections.heading: Ready-made gallery pieces
sections.body: For paintings purchased ready-made (status "Ready" at the time of order), returns are accepted within [X] days of delivery, provided the item is in its original condition.

sections.heading: Custom commissions
sections.body: Paintings made to a custom order are generally non-returnable given their personalized nature — except in cases of damage during shipping.

sections.heading: Damage in transit
sections.body: If your painting arrives damaged, contact us within 48 hours with photos of the damage — we'll arrange a replacement or a full refund.

sections.heading: How to request a return
sections.body: Email maryna.timchenko.art@gmail.com with your order number and the reason for the return. We'll respond within [X] business days.

solidarity.heading: Our position
solidarity.body: We are Timchenko Art, and we don't stay silent. We openly condemn the Russian Federation's armed aggression against Ukraine and the other countries it has attacked in the past. In light of this, we do not accept orders from customers based in Russia.
